Frequently asked questions

Where should we eat in Oslo tonight?+

Check today's weekday in the “By day” list above — many Oslo deals only apply on certain days and hours. Pick the current day, see which venues have a live deal, and book it in the BIMM app. If nothing matches today, the venues under “Any day” have no day restriction.

What if we can't agree?+

Let the wallet decide: scroll to “Biggest savings first” and pick the deal at the top of the list. Nobody argues with 2 for 1.

Does it cost anything?+

BIMM Premium costs 49 NOK/mo, or 295 NOK/yr (24.58 NOK/mo), and unlocks the deals. You can cancel anytime and there are no hidden fees. Stamp-card loyalty rewards are free to use — no subscription needed.

Do we need to book a table?+

In BIMM you book the deal itself for a date and time, then show up and check in with the app at the venue — no coupons or codes. If you want to be sure of a table, contact the venue directly.
